brief.headline: Push for the ₹66.48/KG price we already pay Sayaji and qualify a second supplier — they hold 56% of our Dextrose spend and have no public financials to lean on

priceAsk.summary: Match the ₹66.48/KG we pay Sayaji Industries Limited for Dextrose
priceAsk.basis: We're paying them ₹68.45/KG, which is 3.0% more than our best price. The open market asks ₹60–81/kg (typically ₹66–73/kg), so our target sits inside the typical band and is already a price we pay someone else for the same material.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep the current 30 days — no change needed

brief.financialLeverage: Gujarat Ambuja publishes no financials, so we can't see their revenue, debt or how tight their cash is. That means we build our case on what we do know: we spend ₹21.21 Cr with them — 56% of our Dextrose — making us a major customer. Without their financial picture we can't judge how hard to push, so the safe play is to anchor the price ask to the ₹66.48/KG we already pay elsewhere and focus on lining up a credible second source to reduce our dependence and strengthen our hand long-term.

evidence.point: We pay them more than our cheapest supplier
evidence.figure: ₹68.45/KG vs ₹66.48/KG (Sayaji Industries Limited) — a 3.0% gap costing us ₹1.26 Cr a year

evidence.point: They supply over half our Dextrose
The market asking price supports our target
evidence.figure: Anhydrous Dextrose IP asks ₹60–81/kg (typically ₹66–73/kg) — verdict: MARKET-FAIR (slightly favourable)

evidence.point: India's export benchmark is well below what we pay
evidence.figure: India export unit value: 42.95 ₹/kg — our price is higher, so there's room

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker with ₹2359.06 Cr revenue and a B health score (62/100) — established dextrose supplier and a direct drop-in for Gujarat Ambuja/Sayaji

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist (₹821.13 Cr revenue, C health 53/100) making starch and dextrose with growing capacity

alternates.name: Roquette India Pvt Ltd (a lead to qualify)
alternates.why: Indian arm of global starch major Roquette (₹2898.05 Cr revenue) — pharma-grade dextrose and excipients, premium quality and very reliable; verify before RFQ

risks: They're our only big supplier for Dextrose (56% of spend) — pushing too hard without a qualified backup risks supply if they push back or walk
No public financials means we're flying blind on their financial strength — we don't know if they're stable or struggling, so can't calibrate how aggressive to be
Qualifying a second source (Gulshan, Sanstar or Roquette India) takes time — start the technical and audit process now so we have real leverage in the next round
The market ask (₹60–81/kg) shows a wide band — if they argue quality or service justifies the premium, be ready to cite the ₹66.48/KG we already pay for IP-grade material
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but we're paying you ₹68.45/KG when we pay Sayaji ₹66.48/KG for the same Dextrose — let's talk about closing that gap and aligning to the price we know works.
